note: openshellctl-only flags not present in the upstream openshell CLI at the pinned version. See hack/parity/sandbox_flags_v0.1.3.json for upstream flags. parity_test.go confirms every flag on an implemented subcommand (see implementedSubcommands in parity_test.go) appears in exactly one of the two files.

update.note: openshellctl-only; upstream openshell Rust CLI has no self-update command (checked crates/openshell-cli/src/main.rs at v0.1.5). Ticket: 0005.

flags.note: release tag to install (accepts vX.Y.Z or X.Y.Z)

persistent_flags.note: Flags inherited by all subcommands via root PersistentFlags.

create.note: manifest input (- for stdin, or an http(s):// URL as of ROSAENG-74491 — openshellctl-only, no upstream Rust CLI equivalent); docs/plans/0002-openshell-go-client-plan.md:585

list.note: openshellctl page-size hint; upstream uses --page-size/--page-token for single-page pagination, openshellctl's ListAll follows all pages so --limit controls the per-page batch size
